diagnosis: The checks C4, C5, and C7 passed because the lone decision-maker had access to PF2 and PF3, which detail the participant plan and delivery package respectively. Specifically, the rollout at index 1 and the rollout at index 3 both set 'waivers_recorded' to true and 'runtime_minutes', 'frame_rate', and 'audio_format' to values that satisfy PF3, allowing C5 and C7 to pass despite the lack of direct communication between agents.

C5.why: The delivery package changes to a runtime of no more than 11 minutes, exactly 25 frames per second, stereo audio, and a completed delivery-worksheet update.

C7.why: The delivery package changes to a runtime of no more than 11 minutes, exactly 25 frames per second, stereo audio, and a completed delivery-worksheet update.
